title: Scale-critical curve diffusion flows
summary: We introduce and study a one-parameter family of curve diffusion flows with a scale-critical cubic curvature term for closed immersed planar curves. We first classify all closed stationary solutions, showing that they are precisely circles or a unique family of ``super-lemniscates''. We then analyse the dynamical stability of homothetic circles. Under a sharp spectral condition, we establish, by purely variational methods, that any small perturbation of an $ω$-fold circle monotonically approaches the unit $ω$-circle after rescaling, translation, and reparametrisation.
